name: Kixie
summary: Power dialer with SMS and CRM integration for outbound sales teams. Kixie publishes no seat price: three tiers separated by how many lines they dial, with the multi-line AI voice detection, ConnectionBoost, Conversation Intelligence and DNC compliance all sold as add-ons on top.
best_for: outbound sales teams living in their CRM that want a serious power dialer with local presence, SMS and automation
skip_if: low call volumes (per-seat + minutes math won't pay back), or you want monthly flexibility without contract fine print
honest_knock: Plan for 30-60% above the sticker: minutes, the multi-line dialer and AI human-voice-detection all bill separately, and the quarterly auto-renewing contract only allows downgrades in its final 30 days — read that clause before signing. The dialer itself is genuinely fast and CRM-native; just buy it with the full basket priced and the calendar reminder set (our Renewal Radar exists for exactly this).

pricing.notes: (2026-09-10, read on their own pricing page) No seat price is published. Three plans are listed — Professional, Single-Line PowerDialer and Multi-Line PowerDialer — and no amount is rendered anywhere on the page; the billing toggle that used to sit above the cards has gone too, so there is now no path from this page to a number. The core phone system is identical on all three; what separates them is dialling. There is no PowerDialer on Professional, one line on Single-Line, and up to four simultaneous lines on Multi-Line — also the only tier offering AI human voice detection, as a premium add-on. ConnectionBoost, Conversation Intelligence and DNC compliance are add-ons at every tier. The plan cards claim unlimited US/Canada minutes while the FAQ published in the page's own structured data prices unlimited US and Canada minutes at $30 a month per user, so which of the two applies belongs in writing in your quote. First US/Canada number free, extra local numbers $5.00 a month, porting in free. Texts from $0.011 each ($11 per 1,000) on a registered 10DLC number, inbound free. 7-day trial, no credit card.
